chapter: Lee Collins and the riverboat Washington
title: Riverboat routes and the fall into the liquor stash
summary: He starts describing riverboat excursions and the baseball game.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Yeah William and on and all that bunch. See Lee used to teach a lot of them white boys. See how Louis Prem and them, Mom and them used to have groceries and things, bring them, put the sticks and stuff around there, show them how to make all them runs on the trumpet. What was it like being on one of those riverboats? Well, in the wintertime those folks used to carry cotton up in the Washtenaw River. See they would go from here to angle, branch off and angle, what they call the old river, through the Red River, and the Tennisaw River, and the Beck River used to cross the Red River, into the Black River. The Black River would go, the Red River would go into the Black River and at Harrisonburg, we'd run excursions there, the Black River, and then when Black River would get to Jonesville, it would be the Washtenaw River. And that Washtenaw River would bring you all through Monroe and all the way up there. And Caggan Arkansas, we used to give excursions from Caggan Arkansas, that was twelve miles from Elvus Reda when I was on that boat with St. Sun White in there. And we was playing ball out there one day, you know, and we was playing with the Den of Sheens in there, all of them, with the passengers and everything, we was playing ball out there. The guy hit a line drive out there, man, and I fell right in one of them stills. You know like, we used to catch them lines with Frank Buck, bring them back, you know, all them old Jimmy Jones, we fell right down in there.

Fell down in there where they had the stuffed stash, not the still. And they got some routers on the bottom deck to bring that thing there, everybody was drunk on that boat because we got the cam and then come back. We bought suitcases with our clothes and went out there and loaded up, you know, big old Jimmy Jones, the first three full top ones we took that off and said it might be poison, we got the ones underneath and brought them down. We used to have some, see, twelve miles from Caggan was Elvus Reda, see, white passengers come down and get on the boat. We used to give all of them excursions.
